QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Outlaw of the Sea
QuestInfo.0: Grosso Polpo appeared when you were trying to lock up Captain Blood, and Leon was right in its path. You'd have to let the pirate go to save your unlucky friend.
QuestInfo.1: Grosso Polpo appeared when you were trying to lock up Captain Blood, and Leon was right in its path. You'd have to let the pirate go to save your unlucky friend.
QuestInfo.2: You shooed away Grosso Polpo, but the beast certainly lived up to its nickname, the outlaw of the sea. It seemed to be toying with you... but will it ever come face you in earnest?

mob.0: Oh man, Grosso Polpo at a time like this?
